shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material and fur texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must name the color instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the main subject of the photo whole inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps it whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.edit: This is a precise edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph with one detail changed. Change only what the instruction names.

reference_file.observed_description: One wooden chair painted solid green stands alone on a light wooden floor in front of a plain pale wall.

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows one green wooden chair. Keep the photograph exactly as it is: the same wooden chair, shape, position, floor, wall, light and framing. Change ONLY the color of the wooden chair: it is now solid chocolate BROWN paint instead of green, every painted part alike. Nothing else changes.

reference_file.observed_description: One bright-yellow backpack stands upright alone on a plain light-grey floor in front of a plain light-grey wall.

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows one yellow backpack. Keep the photograph exactly as it is: the same backpack, shape, position, floor, wall, light and framing. Change ONLY the color of the backpack: it is now solid strong violet PURPLE instead of yellow, fabric, straps and zipper tape alike. Nothing else changes.

reference_file.observed_description: One bicycle with a solid bright-blue frame, black tires and a black seat stands alone in side view on a light-grey path in front of a plain pale-beige wall.

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows one bicycle with a blue frame. Keep the photograph exactly as it is: the same bicycle, position, tires, seat, path, wall, light and framing. Change ONLY the color of the frame: it is now solid bright rose PINK instead of blue. The tires and the seat stay black. Nothing else changes.
